scope: curated—not exhaustive; verified venue status where available

clusters.name: 1 · Memory writing, updates & consolidation
clusters.description: What persists; corrections, temporal events, graph links, semantic updates.

clusters.name: 2 · Retrieval, multi-hop evidence & rank fusion
clusters.description: How the right memory record is found among many.

clusters.name: 3 · Hierarchies, compression & cache tiers
clusters.description: How to afford long histories without destroying useful detail.

clusters.name: 4 · Learned routing, budgets & memory actions
clusters.description: Which operation/configuration should be chosen for this query?

clusters.name: 5 · Inter-agent directory, routing & message cost
clusters.description: Which agent knows, communicates, or takes responsibility?

clusters.name: 6 · Provenance, access control & truth maintenance
clusters.description: What the agent may see, and whether evidence is current and justified.

clusters.name: 7 · Workloads & benchmarks
clusters.description: Which tasks expose long-term memory failures?

papers.title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
papers.mechanism: Memory stream ranked by recency, importance and relevance; reflection builds higher-level memories.
papers.limit: Agent simulation and language reasoning go beyond classical caching.

papers.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
papers.mechanism: Store verbal feedback as episodic memory and reuse it on subsequent attempts.
papers.limit: The stored artifact is a learned natural-language lesson, not merely a cached query result.

papers.title: Interleaving Retrieval with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning (IRCoT)
papers.mechanism: Alternate intermediate reasoning with retrieval to obtain multi-hop evidence.
papers.limit: Correctness depends on generated intermediate steps and retrieval accuracy.

papers.title: Active Retrieval Augmented Generation (FLARE)
papers.mechanism: Predict forthcoming sentences, retrieve context proactively, revise uncertain generations.
papers.limit: More than static retrieval; uncertainty-conditioned LLM generation.

papers.title: LoCoMo: Evaluating Very Long-Term Conversational Memory of LLM Agents
papers.mechanism: Long multi-session conversations with questions about speaker information, chronology and reasoning.
papers.limit: Benchmark, not a memory mechanism.

papers.title: RAPTOR: Recursive Abstractive Processing for Tree-Organized Retrieval
papers.mechanism: Cluster and summarize documents recursively; retrieve across a hierarchy of abstraction.
papers.limit: Summaries can discard exact facts; structure differs from LRU-style caching.

papers.title: HippoRAG: Neurobiologically Inspired Long-Term Memory for Large Language Models
papers.mechanism: Encode entity associations as a knowledge graph and use Personalized PageRank-style traversal.
papers.limit: KG construction and entity linking are LLM-era decisions; PPR itself is old.

papers.title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate and Critique through Self-Reflection
papers.mechanism: Learn when to retrieve and critique generated text using reflection tokens.
papers.limit: Learned control and answer faithfulness are not ordinary SQL query planning.

papers.title: MetaGPT: Meta Programming for a Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework
papers.mechanism: Specialized roles, SOPs and structured handoffs coordinate LLM agents.
papers.limit: Role handoffs do not establish ZooKeeper-style consistency guarantees.

papers.title: ChatDev: Communicative Agents for Software Development
papers.mechanism: Agents with complementary roles collaborate through chat-chain messages.
papers.limit: Message semantics and generated artifacts differ from a deterministic workflow engine.

papers.title: Improving Factuality and Reasoning in Language Models through Multiagent Debate
papers.mechanism: Multiple language models exchange arguments before consensus.
papers.limit: Debate quality is separate from minimizing routing cost.

papers.title: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory
papers.mechanism: Test information extraction, multi-session synthesis, temporal reasoning, updates and abstention.
papers.limit: End-to-end accuracy and retrieval Recall@K must be reported separately.

papers.title: A-Mem: Agentic Memory for LLM Agents
papers.mechanism: Create memory notes, links and evolved labels; refine relationships as experience arrives.
papers.limit: Link creation is semantic, not a B-tree operation.

papers.title: AgentPrune: An Economical Communication Pipeline for LLM Multi-Agent Systems
papers.mechanism: Prune communication links within a multi-agent interaction graph.
papers.limit: The selected graph affects reasoning quality, unlike ordinary static message filtering.

papers.title: AgentDropout: Dynamic Agent Elimination for Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.mechanism: Remove less useful agents and edges in a task-dependent multi-agent system.
papers.limit: Dropping an agent may remove unique evidence; cannot optimize only message count.

papers.title: MemoryOS: A Memory Operating System for AI Agents
papers.mechanism: Manage short-, mid- and long-term memory with tiering and replacement analogies.
papers.limit: Names borrow OS concepts; actual eviction implementation requires inspection.

papers.title: Mem0: Building Production-Ready AI Agents with Scalable Long-Term Memory
papers.mechanism: Extract, consolidate, update and retrieve persistent memories; includes graph-enhanced variant.
papers.limit: Compare concrete write/update semantics, not merely vector-store presence.

papers.title: MindForge: Empowering Embodied Agents with Theory of Mind for Lifelong Cultural Learning
papers.mechanism: Maintain and share agent-specific evolving social/cultural knowledge.
papers.limit: Communication includes interpretation of other agents' beliefs.

papers.title: LightMem: Lightweight and Efficient Agent Memory
papers.mechanism: Separate short-term sensory processing and longer-term offline consolidation.
papers.limit: Offline consolidation is not interchangeable with caching.

papers.title: AssoMem: Scalable Memory for Language Agents via Associative Retrieval
papers.mechanism: Use associative links and temporal/importance signals to recover dispersed clues.
papers.limit: Learned association and LLM-derived links matter beyond graph search itself.

papers.title: AdaMEM: Test-Time Adaptive Memory for Language Agents
papers.mechanism: Combine long-term trajectory memory with short-term generated strategy guidance.
papers.limit: Adaptation targets evolving agent decisions, not just the index access path.

papers.title: Memory-R1: Enhancing Large Language Model Agents to Actively Manage and Utilize External Memory
papers.mechanism: Use reinforcement learning for memory operations such as adding, updating and retrieving.
papers.limit: Agent feedback and write correctness differ from selecting a physical DB index.

papers.title: AgeMem: Unified Short- and Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents
papers.mechanism: Train a unified policy over short- and long-term memory operations.
papers.limit: Joint action policy is not merely rank fusion.

papers.title: Memora: Improving Agent Memory with Cue-Based Retrieval
papers.mechanism: Preserve explicit retrieval cues and specific details while abstracting experiences.
papers.limit: LLM abstraction and selective retention introduce semantic information loss.

papers.title: APDMem: Adaptive Progressive Distillation for Agent Memory
papers.mechanism: Progressive hierarchical memory distilled to reduce cost and improve retrieval.
papers.limit: Industry deployment metrics and task datasets determine novelty.

papers.title: AtomMem: Structured Atomic Memory for Long-Term Conversations
papers.mechanism: Represent atomic facts, event hierarchy and temporal profiles for evidence retrieval.
papers.limit: Different work from the learned-operation AtomMem below.

papers.title: AtomMem: Learnable Memory Operations for Agents
papers.mechanism: Learn summarization and memory-management actions over interaction histories.
papers.limit: Distinct paper from fact-structured AtomMem despite shared project name.

papers.title: MemMA: Memory-Centric Multi-Agent Reasoning
papers.mechanism: Use agents to assess and repair memory through QA and collaborative reasoning.
papers.limit: Multiple agent roles incur new coordination overhead.

papers.title: COLLABMEM: Collaborative Memory for Multi-Agent Systems
papers.mechanism: Share and route memory between agents, including cooperation and conflicts.
papers.limit: Agent-level access and ownership constraints go beyond distributed document selection.

papers.title: CIMemories: Role-Aware Private Memories for Multi-Agent Systems
papers.mechanism: Partition and use memory according to agent roles and privacy constraints.
papers.limit: Hard authorization must precede relevance ranking.

papers.title: HELM: Grounded and Controlled Memory for Language Agents
papers.mechanism: Track evidence provenance, freshness and knowledge-status distinctions.
papers.limit: A new output-grounding problem, despite old provenance theory.

papers.title: ShardMemo: Scope-Before-Routing for Agentic Memory Retrieval
papers.mechanism: Filter permissible memory shards first, then learn a shard router for budgeted ANN retrieval.
papers.limit: Very close to an agent-memory query-plan proposal; not a main-track EMNLP paper.

papers.title: VikingMem: A Memory Base Management System for Stateful LLM Applications
papers.mechanism: Event/entity abstractions, temporal consolidation, fading and state evolution on a vector engine.
papers.limit: Agent-native memory DB management is already a researched systems problem.

papers.title: Hierarchical Long-Term Semantic Memory for LinkedIn's Hiring Agent
papers.mechanism: Schema-aligned tree, provenance, privacy-aware low-latency retrieval and production deployment.
papers.limit: KDD venue reported by paper lists; use official proceedings to recheck track.

papers.title: MemoryArena: Benchmarking Agent Memory in Interdependent Multi-Session Tasks
papers.mechanism: Agent tasks where memory is useful for later decisions, not solely QA recall.
papers.limit: Benchmarks action success; not equivalent to LongMemEval Recall@K.

papers.title: AgentSelect: Benchmark for Narrative Query-to-Agent Recommendation
papers.mechanism: Recommend capable agent configurations using narrative task and capability profiles.
papers.limit: An agent directory has measurable selection/routing baselines already.

papers.title: MemoryAgentBench: Evaluating Memory in LLM Agents via Incremental Multi-Turn Interactions
papers.mechanism: Test retrieval, test-time learning, long-range recall and selective forgetting.
papers.limit: Probes skills, not a specific memory index.

papers.title: AMA-Bench: Evaluating Active Memory Agents
papers.mechanism: Benchmark active/strategic agent memory use.
papers.limit: Measure interactive decision quality beyond rank-position recall.

papers.title: LoCoMo-Plus: Long-Term Memory with Latent Constraints
papers.mechanism: Adds harder constraint-sensitive memory situations.
papers.limit: Careful negative controls avoid winning via simple chronology cues.

papers.title: MemAgent: Learning to Manage Heterogeneous Memory Providers for LLM Agents
papers.mechanism: Learn provider selection, whether to use short-term memory, and where to write experiences.
papers.limit: Major novelty threat to heterogeneous-router proposals; no top-conference acceptance verified.

papers.title: MemForest: An Efficient Agent Memory System with Hierarchical Temporal Indexing
papers.mechanism: Parallel extraction and a temporal tree with local dirty-path maintenance.
papers.limit: Do not label as accepted VLDB 2026; author repository says VLDB 2027 submission.

priors.title: Searching Distributed Collections with Inference Networks
priors.idea: CORI-style distributed collection selection: first select promising collections, then search locally.

priors.title: Reciprocal Rank Fusion Outperforms Condorcet and Individual Rank Learning Methods
priors.idea: Fuse independent ranking lists with a rank-based reciprocal score.

priors.title: ColBERT: Efficient and Effective Passage Search via Contextualized Late Interaction
priors.idea: Token-level late interaction separates candidate search from detailed matching.

priors.title: SPLADE: Sparse Lexical and Expansion Model for First Stage Ranking
priors.idea: Learn sparse lexical expansion for inverted-index-style search.

priors.title: Bao: Making Learned Query Optimization Practical
priors.idea: Contextual bandit chooses query-optimizer hints/plan families under DB workloads.

priors.title: Neo: A Learned Query Optimizer
priors.idea: Learn query plan cost and search strategies.

priors.title: The Case for Learned Index Structures
priors.idea: Replace simple key-to-position interpolation with a trained model.

priors.title: ALEX: An Updatable Adaptive Learned Index
priors.idea: Adapt index model/layout as ordered-key distributions change.

priors.title: DiskANN: Fast Accurate Billion-Point Nearest Neighbor Search on a Single Node
priors.idea: Disk-resident proximity graph for large-scale approximate nearest-neighbor search.

priors.title: Efficient and Robust Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search Using Hierarchical Navigable Small World Graphs
priors.idea: Approximate nearest-neighbor graph search; no universal logarithmic time bound.

priors.title: The LRU-K Page Replacement Algorithm for Database Disk Buffering
priors.idea: Eviction decisions use history of the last K references.

priors.title: ARC: A Self-Tuning, Low-Overhead Replacement Cache

priors.title: ZooKeeper: Wait-free Coordination for Internet-Scale Systems
priors.idea: Coordination service with ordered updates and distributed state.

priors.title: Why and Where: A Characterization of Data Provenance
priors.idea: Formalize which source data contributes to an output and where values came from.

priors.title: HAMMER: An Automatic RAG Tuning System via Hierarchical Memory-Guided Monte Carlo Tree Search
priors.idea: Tune RAG pipeline configurations automatically with hierarchical memory-guided search.

priors.title: HIRE: A Hybrid Learned Index for Mixed Workloads
priors.idea: Hybrid learned indexes with updates and latency constraints.

priors.title: Curator: Efficient Vector Search with Low-Selectivity Filters
priors.idea: Approximate vector search under restrictive structured filters.

priors.title: HONEYBEE: Role-Based Access Control for Vector Databases via Dynamic Partitioning
priors.idea: Apply role-based access restrictions to vector retrieval with partitioned data.

priors.title: Scaling Personalized Web Search
priors.idea: Personalized PageRank-based scoring with user-specific bias and graph walk.

priors.title: The Design of the POSTGRES Storage System
priors.idea: Historical versions/time-travel semantics as data-management primitives.

mappings.shared: Select a plan/policy conditioned on the incoming request.
mappings.different: Agent actions alter language reasoning and evidence correctness; DB plan selection preserves SQL semantics.
mappings.experiment: Best fixed retrieval stack vs cost-aware query router, identical corpus/model/budget.

mappings.shared: Both learn a policy over discrete system choices.
mappings.different: Memory CRUD affects future agent state, not just one read's execution latency.
mappings.experiment: Train write and read decisions separately; evaluate future-query leakage, utility and regret.

mappings.shared: Personalized graph traversal/relevance propagation is a reused primitive.
mappings.different: Graph nodes and edges are extracted from LLM memories and may be wrong.
mappings.experiment: Graph enabled vs disabled; hold graph construction constant when comparing PPR variants.

mappings.shared: Evidence retrieval combines lexical, semantic and graph/multi-view signals.
mappings.different: Rank fusion does not guarantee multi-hop evidence completeness.
mappings.experiment: BM25/dense/RRF/graph ablation at fixed top 10 and top 15 evidence budget.

mappings.shared: Both allocate attention/storage according to expected utility and cost.
mappings.different: Hierarchical summarization changes content; ARC changes which unchanged objects reside in cache.
mappings.experiment: Measure summary-induced forgetting separately from cache misses and p95 latency.

mappings.shared: Hot/cold memory and adaptive admission/eviction are established cache families.
mappings.different: A selected episodic memory affects answer quality, not solely future cache hits.
mappings.experiment: ARC/LRU-K-style utility cache vs simple recency under equal tokens/bytes.

mappings.shared: Select which resource/agent is likely to contain relevant knowledge before deeper search.
mappings.different: Agents can act, negotiate and refuse; collections are passive document sets.
mappings.experiment: Top-m agent recall, useful-owner coverage, message/token savings, failure-to-route.

mappings.different: Edge pruning alters dialogue topology; ZooKeeper handles distributed coordination state, not semantic expertise.
mappings.experiment: Pruning vs collection-selection vs broadcast with controlled expertise overlap.

mappings.shared: Both decompose coordination into roles and explicit handoffs.
mappings.different: Neither claims ZooKeeper consensus, ordering guarantees or fault tolerance.
mappings.experiment: Perturb delayed messages and missing participants; evaluate failure recovery.

mappings.shared: Hard role/scope filters constrain vector retrieval before ranking.
mappings.different: LLM agents add delegated authority and implicit information leakage.
mappings.experiment: Filter-before-route vs filter-after-retrieve; test unauthorized recall and allowed Recall@10.

mappings.shared: Track source lineage and use it to justify returned evidence.
mappings.different: Generated summaries may invent unsupported claims; provenance is necessary but insufficient.
mappings.experiment: Stale/retracted sources and contradictory updates with auditable lineages.

mappings.shared: Retain historical events, record updates and source information.
mappings.different: Append-only textual facts do not automatically implement ACID or MVCC guarantees.
mappings.experiment: Fact correction test: can system answer both current and as-of-date queries?

mappings.shared: Memory/index structure can change with updates and query distribution.
mappings.different: Learned index papers predict key positions; memory papers infer semantic representations.
mappings.experiment: Measure update-to-queryable time, rebuild cost and evidence freshness.

mappings.shared: Combine ANN with structured filters and multiple candidate scopes.
mappings.different: The role/shard predicate must be a semantic security contract, not a probabilistic guess.
mappings.experiment: Exact prefilter vs ANN postfilter under equal admissible recall and latency.

mappings.shared: Condition retrieval effort and sequence on incoming uncertainty or task needs.
mappings.different: Intermediate natural-language reasoning can drift, unlike deterministic query plans.
mappings.experiment: Single-shot RAG vs stepwise query planning vs learned budgeting.

mappings.shared: Both fields require controlled workloads, cost and failure measurements.
mappings.different: Benchmarks define a different task; there is no one-to-one algorithmic equivalence.
mappings.experiment: Report retrieval success, answer accuracy, stale memory and routing correctness separately.

mappings.shared: Treat agent ownership as resource ranking and combine evidence from selected sources.
mappings.different: Privacy, cooperation, conflicts and credit assignment remain agent-native.
mappings.experiment: Use soft routing with a hard access mask and per-agent evidence trace.

mappings.shared: Heterogeneous providers are selected adaptively rather than always queried.
mappings.different: Already heavily explored in 2026; novelty requires a new constraint or demonstrable effect.
mappings.experiment: Oracle routing headroom minus best fixed configuration, plus routing overhead.

glossary: Agent memory
A persistent store of facts, episodes or strategies that an agent may use after the original context disappears.
Memory write path
How raw interaction becomes an indexed, updated, versioned or summarized memory record.
Retrieval path
A way to find candidate memories: dense vector, sparse term match, graph, time or metadata.
Query optimizer / planner
A component that chooses which retrieval path(s) to use and how much effort to allocate.
Agent directory
A catalog of which agents can answer which categories or hold which knowledge.
Recall@K
The fraction of relevant gold evidence items found in the top K retrieved results; not answer accuracy.
Oracle headroom
The performance gap between the best global fixed setting and an unrealistically perfect per-query chooser.
Provenance
Information about which inputs and transformations justify a retrieved fact or answer.
Filtered ANN
Nearest-neighbor search restricted to records that satisfy hard predicates such as ownership or time.
RRF
Reciprocal Rank Fusion: combine several rank-ordered lists without requiring comparable raw scores.
Hot/cold cache
Tiered storage: frequently useful items live in a faster/smaller tier while less-used history lives elsewhere.
Exact match versus analogy
Direct = a reused algorithm; strong = same operational decision; analogy = a related systems intuition, not the same algorithm.
